findings.label: M-01
findings.title: MEV / first-claimer front-run of winner-take-all nudge pot
findings.note: NEW at run phoenix-nft-staking-13. Distinct root cause from H-01 (mempool race vs. value-blind gate). Report generated and PoC (poc-MevFrontrunNudge.t.sol) validated passing; moved to submitted. [TRIAGE 2026-05-29] Accepted — valid finding. Mitigation: introduce a `minRewardPayout` parameter so the claimer can use AMM-style slippage mechanics to revert the transaction if their expected reward has been front-run/claimed. This protects an honest batch-minter from spending a large sum and receiving nothing. [TRIAGE 2026-05-30] ACCEPTED as residual (user triage 2026-05-30). Threat model verified against batchMint @ 9be4a87: (cond.2) claiming the nudge requires paying nudgeSize×mintPrice for real mints — the owner-pinned minter/dispatcher (story-009) make a free claim impossible (verified L257-259, L270); (cond.1) the minReward floor (L278-279) reverts the loser's batch atomically so a sniped user never overpays for a gone reward. Winner-take-all MEV capture remains by design and is accepted: nudge reward is a fraction of NFT mint cost, NFTs have no secondary market (only the staking pool), so a pure MEV bot cannot recoup in one tx — a front-runner who claims must genuinely join the protocol, reducing the issue to an ordinary gas auction among real participants. ACCEPTANCE INVARIANT (owner-operational, not code-enforced): keep the nudge pot < nudgeSize×mintPrice; if the yield funnel ever lets the pot exceed the cost of nudgeSize mints, pure-profit MEV returns. Also assumes a non-zero dispatcher mint price when the nudge is funded. [phoenix-nft-staking-16 RE-TRIAGE] The acceptance invariant 'keep pot < nudgeSize x mintPrice' does NOT bound loss if the minted NFTs carry realizable (resellable/redeemable) value: a searcher who realizes NFT value nets ~pot>0 for ANY pot size, so the giveaway is raced to zero on every refill — the 'NFTs have no secondary market' premise of the 2026-05-30 acceptance no longer holds if a market/redemption path exists (RETRIAGE-001 / ECON-002 / cross-ref F-01 lineage). Over-funding facet (PATTERN-002) is a non-obvious Law-3 owner footgun ('fund the incentive' silently == 'set a sweepable bounty'). Severity ceiling RE-CONFIRMED MEDIUM (NOT secretly High: no principal theft, honest minters still receive NFTs and story-015 minReward reverts a sniped honest caller atomically; loss bounded by owner funding; mempool ordering race, not an unconditional drain). [FIXED 2026-06-09] The core actionable harm was honest-user overpayment: a caller pays nudgeSize×mintPrice expecting a reward and receives nothing. This is fully closed by the `minReward` slippage floor (story-015): if the pot has been front-run, the batch reverts atomically and the honest user pays nothing. The remaining race — who wins the pot among qualifying batches — is an accepted gas-auction among genuine protocol participants, each of whom must pay the full mint cost. `nudgeSize` ensures no free-claim path exists (story-009). Marked fixed at HEAD 5f863d27 per owner triage 2026-06-09.
findings.severityNote: [phoenix-nft-staking-14] PARTIALLY MITIGATED by story-015's minReward fix; residual still open at Medium. minReward correctly closes the loser-overpay leg (a sniped honest caller now reverts atomically instead of minting for a gone reward), but does NOT stop the front-runner from WINNING the winner-take-all balance-based pot — the MEV capture root cause persists. Not a regression (never marked fixed). Not re-reported as new (residual of acknowledged). See follow-on L-05 (minReward==0 default opt-out) for the integration footgun this mitigation introduces. Status left acknowledged (authoritative human triage). [phoenix-nft-staking-15] Still present, re-confirmed by PATTERN-003 against HEAD 5f863d2. story-016 strictly MITIGATES the issue further: the snapshot-before-loop change means the winner no longer recoups their own donations, reducing MEV profitability. Not a regression; status left acknowledged (authoritative human triage). [phoenix-nft-staking-16] Re-confirmed present at HEAD 5f863d2 (cold --full re-scan); lastSeenRun bumped to phoenix-nft-staking-16; acknowledged status preserved (see the RE-TRIAGE note in the note field — the acceptance invariant no longer bounds loss if NFTs are realizable). [2026-06-09] FIXED: threat model scoped to honest-user protection (loser-overpay), not MEV race capture. minReward closes the actionable harm; race-to-win is accepted protocol behavior.

findings.label: L-01
findings.title: batchMint lacks nonReentrant; ERC1155 onERC1155Received fires mid-loop
findings.severityNote: [phoenix-nft-staking-14] Re-examined with a decisive validated Tier-3 PoC (poc-L01-reentrancy.t.sol, 4 cases, all pass against real source @ 9be4a87). VERDICT: STAYS LOW. The missing nonReentrant guard is real, but the High escalation (third-party fund theft) is NOT supported: the clean reentrancy theft of an honest multi-mint caller's in-flight funds atomically reverts (the nested frame's forceApprove(minter,0) at L261 revokes the outer loop's approval); the only value-moving reentrancy paths require honest-caller misconfiguration (over-fund + designate attacker as recipient = known-invalid user mistake); the donated-paymentToken sweep is documented intended behavior with an owner rescueERC20 hatch. Recommended fix: add OZ ReentrancyGuard; make the refund credit a recorded amount instead of balanceOf(this). [phoenix-nft-staking-15] Still present, re-confirmed by SLITHER-001/PATTERN-001 against HEAD 5f863d2. Not exploitable beyond Low. Status unchanged (submitted).

findings.label: L-05
findings.title: minReward==0 default silently opts out of the slippage guard
findings.note: NEW Low at run phoenix-nft-staking-14 (untriaged). Root cause: batchMint's minReward (story-015's slippage guard against M-01) defaults to 0 for backward compat; an integrating front-end that omits the param re-exposes M-01 in full. Integration footgun. Distinct from M-01 (this is the opt-out default of the mitigation, not the MEV race itself). [TRIAGE 2026-05-30] WONT-FIX at the contract level (user triage 2026-05-30). The minReward==0 default cannot be removed in-contract: legitimate non-nudge batches (count < nudgeSize) must pass minReward=0, so the contract cannot force a non-zero floor globally. INTEGRATION REQUIREMENT (carried forward, not dropped): user condition 1 ('a normal user never mints-and-gets-zero') holds ONLY if the front-end derives and passes a non-zero, pot-based minReward (AMM-slippage style) for every nudge-qualifying (count >= nudgeSize) batch. This obligation now lives at the integration/UI layer, not the contract. Closed as wont-fix on the contract; the front-end enforcement is the responsible owner of condition 1.

findings.label: M-02
findings.title: emergencyWithdraw skips _recomputeSchedule/_updatePool, leaving stale rewardRate that over-emits the reward budget to surviving stakers
findings.humanReviewFlag: severity (Medium vs High) — confirmed-live with PoC; classifier resolved to MEDIUM (the dramatic 100x drain is Implausible-High only, gated on a post-exit inactivity window the attacker cannot control). High note preserved per conflicting-severity rule.
findings.note: NEW Medium at run phoenix-nft-staking-16 (cold --full re-scan of HEAD 5f863d2). emergencyWithdraw decrements totalStaked but skips _updatePool/_recomputeSchedule and never advances lastRewardTime, so the next _updatePool over-emits the reward budget to survivors by oldTotal/newTotal (100x). Solvency invariant holds throughout (over-draw clamped to rewardBudget at NFTStaker.sol:329) => value-leak / runway drain, NOT insolvency or principal theft. Violates the M-03 'no participation multiplier' Critical Invariant => cross-referenced as spec-conformance F-01 (carries the LIVE Medium per Law 1; NOT collapsed into QA noise). Submission-grade PoC validated PASS (2/2) by poc-validator against unmodified src @ 5f863d2 (workspace/phoenix-nft-staking/test/poc-M02-EmergencyWithdrawOverEmission.t.sol: test_M02_emergencyWithdraw_inflatesSurvivorEmission, test_M02_selfProfit_recoverPrincipalThenSidecarDrains; written GREEN). report-writer emitted the H/M submission; reportPath set. [TRIAGE 2026-06-09] Owner triage (2026-06-09): ACKNOWLEDGED / WON'T-FIX. NFTStaker is deployed and non-upgradeable; the only code fix (the pure-arithmetic rewardRate resize inside emergencyWithdraw) would require redeploying NFTStaker and migrating existing stakers to the new contract. NFTStaker exposes NO migrate-on-behalf mechanism — every position-moving entrypoint (stake/unstake/claim/emergencyWithdraw) is keyed to msg.sender; there is no depositFor / migrator role / batch — so a migration would force every staker to self-exit and re-stake. Owner accepts the residual over-emission rather than force a migration. Operational mitigation (recorded as the basis for won't-fix): the stale-rate window is closable on demand — the owner monitors EmergencyWithdrawn events and calls pullAndRefresh() (onlyOwner; triggers _recomputeSchedule, resizing rewardRate to current totalStaked) promptly after any emergency exit, bounding the leak to the owner's reaction gap; any stake/unstake/claim/topUp/setTargetAPY also resizes the rate. Finding remains VALID (value leak; solvency invariant holds) — status is won't-fix by owner decision, not an invalidation. Documentation note: the submission's 'collapses the runway / runway declines faster' wording (lines 19, 99) should be tightened — the harm is a value transfer to survivors / a failure to extend the runway per the variable-rate spec, NOT a faster-than-no-exit depletion (wall-clock time-to-depletion vs the no-exit baseline is unchanged).

findings.label: L-06
findings.title: Transient solvency-invariant window: topUp/setTargetAPY recompute without pull() over-states rewardBudget by un-pulled mintDebt
findings.note: NEW Low/QA at run phoenix-nft-staking-16. When mintDebt>0 is un-pulled and topUp/setTargetAPY recompute without a preceding pull(), _recomputeSchedule sizes rewardBudget on V=balance+mintDebt, so the 'Solvency holds at ALL times' Critical Invariant is transiently over-stated by exactly mintDebt; self-heals on the next _syncBudget (PoC: NFTStakerF02TransientSolvency). No extractable value (_safePay gates on real balanceOf and reverts on shortfall). Cross-referenced as spec-conformance F-02 (eventually-consistent invariant wording).

findings.label: L-08
findings.title: NFTStakerPriceScaled priceScale magnitude unchecked — silent emission/runway mis-sizing
findings.note: NEW Low/QA at run phoenix-nft-staking-17 (regression scan of the NEW file src/NFTStakerPriceScaled.sol, story-017, HEAD eee9d3a). NFTStakerPriceScaled's immutable priceScale is unbounded and decimal-unchecked (constructor only guards != 0 at L230); a wrong-magnitude deploy value silently mis-sizes the emission rate/runway (too-high => runway collapse/premature depletion; too-low => re-introduces floor-to-zero) when _recomputeSchedule multiplies latestPrice * priceScale (L435). Solvency-safe (payouts bounded by funded balance via _safePay shortfall-revert) and owner-correctable via setTargetAPY. Law-3 NON-obvious deploy-time configuration footgun, in scope; distinct from the absurd-overflow obvious-misconfig leg (PS-004) correctly suppressed in dedup. Recommend a deploy-time assert priceScale == 10**(rewardDecimals - priceDecimals). origin=new; no prior fingerprint (new contract).

findings.label: M-01
findings.title: Linear-depletion rate-drift: per-interaction full-window re-spread leaves active stakers under-earning (~63.26% delivered) and the budget never depletes
findings.note: NEW Medium at run phoenix-nft-staking-18 (story-018, NFTStakerDepletion is a new linear-depletion contract). _recomputeSchedule/_syncBudget re-spread the full remaining budget over a fresh full depletion window on every interaction, so the depletion horizon never elapses and the budget is asymptotically re-deferred: active stakers receive only ~63.26% of the intended linear-depletion emission (~37% shortfall) and the budget never fully depletes. Same per-interaction full-window re-spread root-cause class as the phlimbo Linear-Depletion bug. Solvency-safe (payouts bounded by funded balance); value-delivery / protocol-function deviation, not theft. PoC PASSING (workspace/phoenix-nft-staking/test/PoC_DepletionRateDrift.t.sol, validated). Also tracked as spec-conformance F-18-01 (story-018 deviation) per Law 2 — carries the live Medium per Law 1. Submission emitted; status submitted. [TRIAGE 2026-06-25] ACKNOWLEDGED / WILL-FIX (owner triage 2026-06-25). Owner has accepted the finding and intends to fix it. AGREED DESIGN CLARIFICATION: a non-zero `pull` inflow means a new NFT was minted = a genuine budget increase, so RESTARTING the depletion window (windowEnd = now + windowSeconds) on a real inflow is INTENDED and is being KEPT. The fix only stops the window/rate recompute on interactions that did NOT change the budget. FIX PLAN recorded at reports/phoenix-nft-staking-18/fix-plan-M-01.md. Summary: (1) gate the `_syncBudget` recompute on inflow > 0 (move `_recomputeSchedule()` inside the `if (inflow > 0)` block; drop the unconditional and no-hook-branch recomputes); (2) remove the vestigial stake/unstake tail recomputes at L565/L585 (rate is totalStaked-independent — they only reset the deadline); (3) leave `_updatePool` per-interaction and the config-setter recomputes untouched. FIX IS SPECIFIC TO NFTStakerDepletion — must NOT be mirrored into NFTStaker / NFTStakerPriceScaled (those use the budget-independent APY/runway model where per-interaction recompute is correct). Finding remains VALID — status is acknowledged (will-fix) by owner decision, not an invalidation. Authoritative human triage: do NOT auto-overwrite on future runs. [FIXED 2026-06-25] Fixed upstream by commit 321d0a9 ([story-020] Fix NFTStakerDepletion rate-drift (audit M-01)), landed on top of the run-18 baseline 24acff8. The fix matches fix-plan-M-01.md EXACTLY, all three parts: (1) _syncBudget no-hook branch now just returns (no recompute) and the recompute is moved inside the `if (inflow > 0)` block; (2) stake tail _recomputeSchedule() removed; (3) unstake tail _recomputeSchedule() removed. _updatePool stays per-interaction; config-setter recomputes untouched; restart-on-mint (non-zero pull) preserved as intended. VERIFICATION (PoC-replay at 321d0a9): upstream shipped a regression test test/PoC_DepletionRateDrift.t.sol with 3 tests — test_M01_activeMatchesPassive_noRateDrift, test_M01_restartOnMint_preserved, test_M01_zeroInflowPullAndRefresh_isNoop — ALL PASS. Active staker now receives 1,199,999.99e18 == passive (was 63.26% / 759,150e18 before); stranded collapsed to 25,392,000 wei of floor dust (was 440,849e18); rewardRate constant 38,051,750,380,517,503 across 365 daily claims (no decay); windowEnd constant 63,072,001 (no drift). Full suite test/NFTStakerDepletion.t.sol: 27/27 pass, no regressions. Recheck fields set (lastRecheckedCommit=321d0a9, recheckResult=LIKELY-FIXED, lastRecheckedAt=2026-06-25). NOTE: lastAuditedCommit deliberately LEFT at 24acff8 — this was a single-finding PoC-replay verification, NOT a full regression scan at 321d0a9; a future regression run still owes a cold pass over 321d0a9 (see WATCH-18-cold-pass-321d0a9). F-18-01 faithfulness deviation (shares this fingerprint) is resolved concurrently.

findings.label: L-01
findings.title: InPlaceNFTStakerMigrator constructor lacks stakedId/stakedToken cross-check — strandable parked principal on owner mis-wire
findings.note: NEW Low at run phoenix-nft-staking-18 (story-019, new InPlaceNFTStakerMigrator). Constructor wires source/destination stakers without asserting stakedId/stakedToken consistency; an owner mis-wire can strand principal parked in the migrator mid-migration. Law-3 non-obvious deploy-time configuration footgun (in scope); no attacker, no theft, avoidable with a correct deploy. Bundled in QA report. Recommend a constructor cross-check asserting stakedToken/stakedId parity across the wired stakers.

findings.label: L-02
findings.title: NFTStakerDepletion._syncBudget un-try/catch'd dispatcherHook.pull() lets an unauthorized hook DoS interactions and initiateMigration
findings.note: NEW Low at run phoenix-nft-staking-18 (story-018). _syncBudget calls dispatcherHook.pull() without try/catch; a reverting/unauthorized hook propagates the revert and bricks every _syncBudget caller — staker interactions and initiateMigration. Availability-only, owner-recoverable (re-point/clear the hook); no theft. Bundled in QA report. Recommend wrapping pull() in try/catch and skipping (with an event) on failure.

findings.label: L-03
findings.title: stake/unstake/claim not poolState-gated during Migrating (no auto-pause) — asymmetric vs depositFor which IS Active-gated
findings.note: NEW Low at run phoenix-nft-staking-18 (story-018). stake/unstake/claim are not poolState-gated during the Migrating state and there is no auto-pause, asymmetric with depositFor which IS Active-gated, so positions can still be mutated while a migration runs. Value-conserving (no asset risk); state-handling/consistency QA. Bundled in QA report. Recommend gating stake/unstake/claim consistently with depositFor or auto-pausing position-mutating entrypoints during Migrating.
